video_caption: The video segment begins with a view of a full moon slowly being covered by an eclipse. A male voice comments on the event, calling it surprisingly early for him. Then, the video cuts to a black telephoto lens attached to a camera tripod. A green Raspberry Pi computer module is perched on top of the lens, held in place by a blue wire. The telephoto lens has two adjustment rings on it for the photographer to adjust focal zoom and aperture. The video then transitions to a closer shot showing an adapter ring for a camera lens next to a Raspberry Pi camera module.
